$comment: Shape of a live record seen on 18 Sep 2026; uid and clsbox are synthesised, the payload is as observed. Dialect B (bare names, string counters) carrying a member no earlier sample had - util_restarted, as an INTEGER next to fourteen strings - and omitting rx_type_arol. 7 of 300 live lorastats records looked like this. VALID, on three grounds worth keeping true: rx_type_arol is optional; dialect detection reads only the thirteen required counters, so a foreign-typed extra member does not make the record 'mixed' (LorastatsDialects.valueShapeOf); and util_restarted has no typed column, so it lands verbatim in data_extra and increments records_unmapped_data_field. If Heimdal keeps sending it, that counter is the signal to give it a column. Also a real example of ts.device two seconds AHEAD of ts.server - inside the skew tolerance, so accepted.
